components.name: ButtonArray
components.description: A row of buttons where one (`type="single"`) or several (`type="multiple"`) are on. Semantics follow the look: single + underlined is a tablist, other single arrays are a radio group (arrow keys move the pick), and multiple arrays are aria-pressed toggle buttons.

props.name: type
props.description: `multiple` lets several items be on at once; state moves to `values`.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretches the array to its container, sharing the width between items.
